SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW t AS select '2011-05-06 07:08:09.1234567' as c, to_timestamp_ntz('2011-05-06 07:08:09.1234567') as
READ	select extract(year from c), extract(year from ntz), extract(year from i) from t
READ	select extract(y from c), extract(y from ntz), extract(y from i) from t
READ	select extract(years from c), extract(years from ntz), extract(years from i) from t
READ	select extract(yr from c), extract(yr from ntz), extract(yr from i) from t

READ	select extract(not_supported from j) from t

READ	select extract('doy', c) from t

READ	select extract('second', c) from t
READ	select c - j from t
READ	select day(c - j) from t
READ	select extract(day from c - j) from t
READ	select extract(month from to_timestamp(c) - i) from t
READ	select extract(second from to_timestamp(c) - j) from t
READ	select extract(YEAR from interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select date_part('YEAR', interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select extract(YEAR from -interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select extract(MONTH from interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select date_part('MONTH', interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select extract(MONTH from -interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select date_part(NULL, interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select extract(DAY from interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select date_part('DAY', interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select date_part('not_supported', interval '2-1' YEAR TO MONTH)
READ	select extract(DAY from interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part('DAY', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(DAY from -interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(HOUR from interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part('HOUR', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(HOUR from -interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(MINUTE from interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part('MINUTE', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(MINUTE from -interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(SECOND from interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part('SECOND', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(SECOND from -interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part(NULL, interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select extract(MONTH from interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select date_part('not_supported', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
READ	select datepart('year', c), datepart('year', ntz), datepart('year', i) from t
READ	select datepart('DAY', interval '123 12:34:56.789123123' DAY TO SECOND)
